# VOwn

> VOwn builds websites, connects business tools, and helps reduce repeat manual tasks. It also develops its own products.

## Pages

- [Home](https://vown.site/): What VOwn builds and how to get in touch.
- [Products](https://vown.site/products): Software tools and product initiatives taking shape at VOwn (Automation Hub, Web Foundations, Operations Engine).
- [About](https://vown.site/about): An introduction to VOwn, our mission, and our 3-step approach to making everyday work easier.
- [Contact](https://vown.site/contact): Project enquiries, product questions, and collaboration.

## Contact
